nodes.label: Azure Blob Storage integration
nodes.rationale: Three authentication methods are offered: connection string (quick but account-wide), shared key (container-scoped but derived from an account key), and Azure AD service principal (recommended for production).

nodes.label: Azure AD service principal authentication
nodes.rationale: Recommended for production. Storage Blob Data Contributor scoped at the container is the least-privilege choice: Reader is insufficient (uploads fail) and Owner grants more than needed. Client secrets expire, which is the most common cause of a storage that worked for months and then failed.
